methodology.timer: Node Web-core invocation only; independent verification/oracle excluded; not browser DOM delivery.
methodology.scope: Every case has exactly one START and a different END. Oracle enumerates all legal paths from that START through maxSteps=2 or 3; both implementations exclude zero-step endpoints.
methodology.ranking: Ordered requirement completion flags, shield combination rank, exact initial combo target, total combo, then fewer steps.
methodology.grouping: Initial combo plus cascade combo; same-group step gaps are compared only at equal higher-priority quality.
methodology.deadline: Returned-result quality and <=160ms delivery are separate; a late result is not counted as a deadline success.
methodology.exclusion: Incomplete oracle runs are excluded from proof-based gaps and recall. No unrestricted 6x6 optimality claim.
methodology.determinism: Seeded boards and search seeds are fixed; wall-clock limited search results may still vary between runs.
